# Nuxie vendored luaur-bytecode 0.1.8 (fork baseline, unmodified)

This directory vendors the crates.io `luaur-bytecode` 0.1.8 package
byte-for-byte as the baseline of the in-house luaur fork (see
`docs/luau-fork.md`). No source changes have been made.

Provenance:

- Package: crates.io `luaur-bytecode` 0.1.8
- Original package checksum:

- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/pjankiewicz/luaur`
- Upstream commit: `f0eac7f7cce691d0cdb0b93c3eef9d599f71d739`
  (`crates/luaur-bytecode`, per `.cargo_vcs_info.json`)
- Luau base: 0.724-era (upstream Luau commit `8f33df9` per the luaur README)
- Patches: none — unmodified fork baseline
